393 likes, 48 comments - microsoft on October 27, 2026: "Accessibility in action. Bringing accessible technology and community together at Crepe Crazy, a Deaf-owned café in Austin.

Video Description: A 42-second event recap video from the Microsoft Accessibility Tech Pop-Up at Crepe Crazy, a Deaf-owned café in Austin, Texas. The video shows attendees gathering at the café, interacting with Microsoft accessibility technology through live demos, connecting with one another, and enjoying the pop-up experience. The recap highlights community, accessible technology, and inclusive design in action.".
